description: Free local target practice. Choose a lane, fire anywhere on the range as the moving reticle crosses the bullseye, and chain 3, 5, or 7 clean hits before time runs out. No wallet, GAS, contract call, or oracle is used; verified GameFi stays closed until the testnet pool is funded and settlement is proven end to end.
